item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Maika-P
  • 発売日: 2006-11-24
  • スコア: 6.279999999999999/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: すぃすぃ- sweetheart swimmer -
  • 英語名: Suisui -sweetheart swimmer-

あらすじ

Shouji is in love with his childhood friend, Medaka. When his mother told him that he has a fiancee, he ran away from home. Then his mother told him, “I don’t care with whom, but you should marry after school graduation.” Thus he started to live in Medaka’s house in another city, and started to attend her school (originally an all-girls school).

Main character is a manga artist waiting for his debut. One day he accidentally obtains a mysterious “Realize Note” with tremendous powers. As a justice warrior “Mobile Suit Gun***” enthusiast, he transforms three girls into justice warrior units. An evil genius plots schemes to acquire these suits.
